visualCharacteristics.purpose: Filter or audience toggle that switches which content is shown: toggle buttons, category pills, dropdown selector with Go, or a results/sort toolbar

contentPattern.structure: One row per filter control. Plain row: cell 1 = label (optional icon), cell 2 = optional filter key matching a section metadata `filter` value. Row with a link = a navigating chip. Row with a list in a cell = a dropdown (cell 1 = label, list items = options; linked items add a Go button, bold text sets its label). Toolbar: plain-text rows (e.g. result count) render as info

reuseGuidance: Use for any pill/toggle/dropdown that filters or routes content. Pair with sections that carry Section Metadata `filter`. Not for tabbed panels with inline content (use tabs-panel).
